dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyue Kiosk Ad
dialogues.text: Our seafood is all fresh outta the ocean, still bright and natural-tasting when it reaches your plate!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyue Kiosk Ad
dialogues.text: Xinyue Kiosk provides the best, authentic Yue-Style cuisine with freshly-caught seafood and a light soup to entertain our taste buds.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyue Kiosk Ad
dialogues.text: If you would like to dine in, please reserve a table at least three months in advance.
